messages.subject: Tomorrow 10:30-11:30: Introducing Positron for Data Science
parts:
Hi D-RUGgies!
Tomorrow 10:30 - 11:30 we will have the next in our weekly series of day science speakers. This week will be *me*, Wesley Brooks, introducing the Positron, which is a program for doing data science coding. It’s got some great features that aren’t available in RStudio so if you're curious then join us in the DataLab conference room, 361 Shields Library.

-Wes
